# Separate receiving review: pre-role adaptive computation

2026-10-29. Accepted mathematical scope relaxation, conditional on the precise common-map boundary below. This does not broaden FTPL learning/regret claims.

The direct prequential proof may condition AFTER the learner has completed, published its current candidate/runtime if desired, and the source has selected its corresponding common next CPTP operation. Pointwise native unbiasedness and any-source loss transfer still apply. The fresh private role/settings are sampled only afterward. Hence arbitrary finite pre-role computation, candidate-dependent pre-role aborts and public candidates do not require a neutral-sampler or conditional uniform-perturbation law for this soundness theorem. Their only possible effect is to alter the current source/memory state and destroy useful acceptance.

Pre-role choices/public records must be functions only of the permitted controller history, not extra measurements or leakage of the unknown payload. Source-memory evolution during this computation is included in the conditioned actual memory state; nothing assumes a reset or frozen environment. A deterministic computation cap may reject before sampling the role. No future or stopped-round call is invented.

The retained post-candidate common-map assumption is stronger than merely hiding a classical role label. Role-dependent preparation duration must not produce a different source-memory evolution or noise map for LEARN versus SERVICE, even without explicit metadata disclosure. Such effects must be equalized or otherwise represented by the genuinely common fixed operation. Source response to the prescribed quantum input under that fixed operation remains allowed. Thus this relaxation removes the fixed LEARNER computation clock, not all physical timing requirements or role/input-setting protection.

The same accepted virtual-label/actual-memory CP argument remains valid because every history-conditioned operation is still a linear CP map and controller acceptance uses permitted classical records. Initial payload-memory correlations remain included.
